# Triangle Flooring

> Triangle Flooring is a licensed and insured flooring contractor based in Palmetto, Florida, serving Bradenton, Sarasota, Lakewood Ranch, Palmetto, Parrish, Venice, St. Petersburg, and Tampa. We install hardwood, luxury vinyl plank (LVP), tile, laminate, and stair treads, plus floor repair and water-damage restoration. Founded by a working installer with 5+ years of hands-on Florida experience, the company has completed 300+ projects with a 5.0 Google rating and offers a 1-year labor warranty plus full manufacturer product warranties (15 years to lifetime).

## Business facts

- **Legal name:** Triangle Flooring
- **Type:** Local flooring contractor (LocalBusiness — HomeAndConstructionBusiness — HomeImprovement)

- **Phone:** +1 (941) 402-6861
- **Email:** trianglefloor@gmail.com
- **Hours:** Monday–Saturday 7:00 AM–7:00 PM ET; closed Sunday
- **License & insurance:** Licensed and insured in the State of Florida
- **Service radius:** ~60 miles from Palmetto, FL (Manatee, Sarasota, Hillsborough, Pinellas counties)
- **Google rating:** 5.0 stars (as of May 2026)
- **Projects completed:** 300+
- **Warranty:** 1-year labor + manufacturer product warranty (15 years to lifetime)
- **Free estimate:** within 24 hours, in-home, written and itemized

## Services offered (with verified pricing ranges, 2026, USD per sq ft installed)

- **Hardwood flooring installation:** $7.35–$20.70 per sq ft installed (engineered and solid; oak, hickory, maple, exotics)
- **Luxury vinyl plank (LVP) installation:** $3.91–$11.11 per sq ft installed (SPC, WPC, glue-down, click-lock; 100% waterproof)
- **Porcelain &amp; ceramic tile installation:** $7.50–$22.00 per sq ft installed (subway, herringbone, large-format, mosaic)
- **Laminate flooring installation:** $3.50–$8.50 per sq ft installed (AC4–AC5 ratings)
- **Stair tread replacement:** $80–$220 per tread installed (oak, maple, hickory, walnut)
- **Floor repair &amp; replacement:** $250–$1,500+ per repair (planks, water damage, squeaks, gaps, transitions)
- **Hardwood refinishing:** $3.50–$7.00 per sq ft (sand, stain, seal, 3 coats poly)

All quotes are itemized in writing — no opaque package pricing.
